verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-class bulk-operation feature. Omnara does offer programmatic control through a REST API (with an OpenAPI spec), a TypeScript SDK and a CLI, so users could script actions across many agents or items. Subagents also let one agent spawn and manage several helpers at once, which gives indirect, workaround-style support. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk or batch operation capability (e.g. batch endpoints or multi-select actions in the dashboard), documentation of acting on many items at once, and any hands-on corroboration.
